children: New Delhi, Nov. 14 -- Listed regional FMCG player, Sheetal Cool Products Limited, has recently announced stock split and bonus issue for investors. The corporate action announcement coincided with nearly 11.39% return over the past one week.

Sheetal Cool Products share price closed 1.11% higher on Friday, November 14, extending its bullish run over the past few months. For investors who closely track the details, here are all the details to know.

The company's board of directors has also "recommended the issue of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 5:1, ie 5 fully paid-up equity shares with a face value of Rs.5 each for holding every single stock of the company. Only eligible investors would receive bonus shares based on the record date.

The board has considered and recommended stock split in the ratio of 1:2. Which means that every company stock (with face value of Rs.10 each), will be split into two stocks (with face value of Rs.5 each).

The board considered and approved "sub-division of 1 (One) Equity Share of face value of Rs. 10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, fully paid-up, into 2 (Two) Equity Shares of face value of Rs. 5/- (Rupees Five only) each, fully paid-up, and consequential alteration of the capital clause of the Memorandum of Association," read the BSE filing released earlier.
Sheetal Cool Products stock split will be subject to the approval of the members and such other statutory, or regulatory approvals as may be required.
The board is yet to notify about the record dates for the two corporate actions. Investors must own the stock before the scheduled record date to qualify for the corporate action.

The stock closed 1.11% higher at Rs.675 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.708.75 crore on Friday, November 13. Its share price value has surged 11.39% over one week, surged 16.33% in two weeks, 54% in six months, and 182% in one year.
